draft.subject: Getting your first project started
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Just checking in as you settle into Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the fastest way to see how it fits your work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
